title: Non-idempotent side-effect compensation
purpose: Bind non-idempotent and reversible privileged tool effects to the canonical durable saga runtime so forward effects cannot be accepted without an exact compensation plan, replay-safe compensation identity, durable progress, and explicit in-doubt recovery.
required_guards: irreversible effects are denied from automatic saga execution
reversible effects require a reversible side-effect class
reversible saga effects require COMPENSATABLE idempotency mode
reversible saga effects require an exact declared compensation tool
compensation tools require mutation authority and replay-safe idempotency
forward execution-in-doubt stops the saga instead of guessing success
compensation execution-in-doubt stops recovery instead of double firing
durable saga ownership fences concurrent recovery coordinators
compensation progress is persisted before terminal completion
